title: Bernstein-Sato ideals for free hyperplane arrangements
summary: Let $f=(f_1,\dots,f_r)$ be a complete factorization of a central hyperplane arrangement $D$ in $X=\mathbb{C}^n$. For a monoid ideal $K\subseteq \mathbb{N}^r$ we study the Bernstein-Sato ideal $B^K_f$ of $f$ along $K$, that is, the $\mathbb{C}[s]$-annihilator of $\mathcal{D}_X[s]f^s/\sum_{m\in K}\mathcal{D}_X[s]f^{s+m}$. When $D$ is free we compute two families of these ideals with the help of AI. For the unit shift $K=\langle e_i\rangle$ we prove that $B^{-e_i}_f$ is generated by an explicit product of linear forms indexed by the dense edges of $D$ contained in $D_i$.
